- Usage charges (through 6/25): USD 42,750
- Committed-capacity credit: -USD 5,000
- Prorated committed fee (6/1–6/30): USD 8,125
- Subtotal: USD 45,875
- Exchange rounding / adjustments: +USD 475
- Provisional total before VAT: USD 46,350

Actions I need from you to finalize the invoice:  
1) Confirm PO number to appear on the invoice (we currently have PO: —).
2) Confirm billing address and VAT number exactly as it should appear.
3) Confirm VAT treatment: is Forestway requesting a VAT invoice or will reverse-charge apply? (I note you're registered in the EU; we want to be sure we apply the right tax treatment.)
4) Preferred payment terms (net 30 vs net 45) and target payment date.

If you can confirm the PO and VAT position by EOD Tue (6/22), we'll issue the final invoice on 6/30 and include the appropriate tax language. If reverse-charge applies we'll include the required EU clause and zero-rate the VAT line.

Attachments: Forestway_VAT_Evidence.xlsx (workbook — provisional line-level detail)

Thanks — I'll loop in Finance/Legal internally once you confirm.
